known_limitation.detail: verify_stale_archive_resurrection_proof requires the archive's review_evidence file, commit, merge_target_ref, and merge_target_sha to equal the current ones (scripts/ai_status.py:7540-7555). But validate_merged_done_evidence records merge_target_sha as the current tip of merge_target_ref via _merged_commit. Any commit to that ref after archival breaks equality. _validated_same_delivery_archive_recovery applies the same four-field equality, and command_retire_archive_collision refuses any row that already has a terminal fact. A row shaped like PPL-ALLOC-007 has no working exit today without a drain marker. Whether to remove or redesign the path is reserved as a separate operator decision.
